newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria depo rates flat in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria depo rates flat in thin trade.

text.p: Bulgaria's interbank deposit rates were unchanged from Friday in thin trade and amid high bank liquidity, dealers said.
"Supply of funds tops demand as market players are bidding for small amounts of levs mainly for short periods. Banks focus on the primary government securities market," said a dealer.
The Finance Ministry offered on Monday two discount T-bills issues with maturities of three and 12 months respectively and with pars of 10 billion and 35 billion levs.
Traders said that interest in those maturities was very large due to high banks' free liquidity.
Overnight interbank depo rates stood at 2.0-2.4 percent annually, unchanged from Friday. Spot week rates were also unchanged at 4.0-4.5 percent.
The average annual interbank deposit rate was 2.13 percent on Friday against 2.46 percent on Thursday, a central bank official said.
The central bank cut its simple annual main interest rate to 6.12 percent from 6.96 percent, effective from Monday. -- Dessislava Popova, Sofia Newsroom +359-2 91188
